behavior: A docs-only change reports only docs, a code change reports its area, and gate passes on success and skipped needs.
gate fails, naming the cause, on a failed or cancelled need, an empty needs and invalid JSON.
A push, a schedule and a dispatch report every area as changed, with full=true.
paths-filter is pinned by full SHA with its tag as a comment.
The README documents the area map, outputs, the if: always() rule and moving branch protection to gate.
verification: grep -q 'if: always()' README.md && grep -q '## changes' README.md && grep -q '## gate' README.md
